properties.statement: Wrote a Python pass over the 167 committed toolsnaps to split every served tool description into sentences, flag the ones asserting what the code does (never/cannot/refuses/only), classify them by reading a random sample, and count them — then repeated it over the 25 skill files. It produced the numbers that settled a design question: 767 sentences, 343 asserting, ~80% checkable, ~100 testable refusal claims, ~6.5 new per week. Nothing in the served surface reads reflow2's OWN prose as data; find_tools returned only itself and this tool for the question.
